mapper.sql: SELECT id, provider, scenario, model_name, display_name, base_url, is_default, supports_tools, supports_streaming, supports_vision, dimension, is_enabled, sort_order, description, context_window_tokens, max_input_tokens, tokenizer_id, supports_prompt_caching, supports_tokenize_api, created_at, updated_at FROM model_catalog
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO model_catalog ( id, provider, scenario, model_name, display_name, base_url, is_default, supports_tools, supports_streaming, supports_vision, dimension, is_enabled, sort_order, description, context_window_tokens, max_input_tokens, tokenizer_id, supports_prompt_caching, supports_tokenize_api, updated_at ) VALUES (#{m.id}, #{m.provider}, #{m.scenario}, #{m.modelName}, #{m.displayName}, #{m.baseUrl}, #{m.default}, #{m.supportsTools}, #{m.supportsStreaming}, #{m.supportsVision}, #{m.dimension}, #{m.enabled}, #{m.sortOrder}, #{m.description}, #{m.contextWindowTokens}, #{m.maxInputTokens}, #{m.tokenizerId}, #{m.supportsPromptCaching}, #{m.supportsTokenizeApi}, now()) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET provider = EXCLUDED.provider, scenario = EXCLUDED.scenario, model_name = EXCLUDED.model_name, display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name, base_url = EXCLUDED.base_url, is_default = EXCLUDED.is_default, supports_tools = EXCLUDED.supports_tools, supports_streaming = EXCLUDED.supports_streaming, supports_vision = EXCLUDED.supports_vision, dimension = EXCLUDED.dimension, is_enabled = EXCLUDED.is_enabled, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order, description = EXCLUDED.description, context_window_tokens = EXCLUDED.context_window_tokens, max_input_tokens = EXCLUDED.max_input_tokens, tokenizer_id = EXCLUDED.tokenizer_id, supports_prompt_caching = EXCLUDED.supports_prompt_caching, supports_tokenize_api = EXCLUDED.supports_tokenize_api, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: WHERE scenario = #{scenario} AND is_default = true AND is_enabled = true LIMIT 1
WHERE scenario = #{scenario} AND model_name = #{modelName} AND is_enabled = true LIMIT 1
